<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Customer Insights Default">191743f62f060b50b14f861cbfa4e3fe</macroponent><name>Refresh Skill Data</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    var interactionDetails = api.data.look_up_interaction_record.result;
    var isActive = interactionDetails.active && interactionDetails.active.value;
    if (!isActive)
        return;
    var shortDesc = (interactionDetails.short_description && interactionDetails.short_description.value) || '';
    var transcript = (interactionDetails.transcript && interactionDetails.transcript.value) || '';
    var hasConsumer = (interactionDetails.consumer && interactionDetails.consumer.value) || '';
    var hasAccount = (interactionDetails.account && interactionDetails.account.value) || '';

    // Check if both entity and context information are present
    var hasEntity = hasConsumer || hasAccount;
    var hasContext = shortDesc || transcript;

    if (hasEntity && hasContext)
        api.data.get_ai_skill_data.refresh();
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-17 02:50:59</sys_created_on><sys_id>611783f62f060b50b14f861cbfa4e315</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Refresh Skill Data</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Pete's Email Engagement Toolkit" source="x_snc_pab_ee_tkit">01900de693acba502e03fde1a903d651</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Pete's Email Engagement Toolkit">01900de693acba502e03fde1a903d651</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_611783f62f060b50b14f861cbfa4e315</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-07-17 02:50:59</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>
